title: An entry in the harness's public goods catalog
description: One education public good: what it is, where it lives, its license and access as its primary sources stated them on verified_at, and the harness slot it would fill. An entry describes; it doesn't endorse. One file per entry in catalog/, named by its id; docs/catalog.md lists them.

id.description: lowercase words joined by hyphens; the file is catalog/<id>.json

summary.description: one plain sentence a teacher who builds software understands

grades.description: the grades as its makers state them (K-12, 6-8, high school), or not stated

repository.description: where its code or data is kept, when that isn't url

spdx.description: every license its parts carry, as SPDX identifiers; empty when none is stated

note.description: which license covers which part, and gated, non-commercial, mixed or conflicting terms

unclear.description: its sources disagree or leave out whether a use is allowed

terms.description: terms of use beyond the license that a person accepts before fetching, such as research use only

expected.description: when it is expected, in its makers' own words and date

slots.description: the harness slots it would fill (docs/components.md); empty for none yet

in_harness.description: the id of the built-in component that carries it

connect.description: How far it is connected (docs/resources.md): 0 listed, 1 fetchable, 2 has an effect in one command, 3 built in

as.description: what it becomes in the harness; empty below level 2

command.description: the exact command, or null at level 0

note.description: at level 2 or 3, what results from it can show and what they can't; below, why it goes no further

verified_at.description: the date its url, license and status were checked against its primary sources
